scope: Independent review of extracted 0065, its compiler prerequisite boundaries and focused native behavior. Does not reuse 0063 approval or approve the entire #321 feature, native LLDB integration, #320, or SNES platform submission.

source_assessment.atomic: Atomic stores are excluded before splitting or arithmetic-coordinated replacement; native word memory operands retain unordered ordering.
source_assessment.volatile: Byte loads are not duplicated and precede low/high stores; replacement word stores retain the original MMO.
source_assessment.calls: Only zero-size ADJCALLSTACKUP is ignored. Calls, inline assembly, nonzero teardown and unsupported uses retain fallbacks.
source_assessment.worklist: Indirect decrement builds an observed G_STORE16_INDIR replacement at the original store and erases the generic operation.
source_assessment.loaded_pointer: The destination must trace to a physical Imag16 argument copy. A loaded pointer fails this gate and retains native lowering.
source_assessment.destination: Exact destination has no native profitability entry point. Extraction preserves upstream scalarization, wide-constant overflow checks and default sign-fill lowering.
source_assessment.purity: No extracted far address spaces, packed pointers, far CC, Imag32, far memory operations, COP addition, proof-recovery pass, or SNES platform code.

resolved_findings.resolution: Native A/X/Y use 0x01000000/1/2; internal high bytes have DwarfNumbers=[-1].
resolved_findings.retrieval: Official-page content retrieved through web search index; direct page fetch returned HTTP 403.

resolved_findings.item: Imported historical comments and far-only comment residue
resolved_findings.resolution: Final patch additions describe current compiler contracts.
validate.py rejects no IR inputs and no parsed function measurements.

nonblocking_findings.detail: Frozen prerequisite patch applies successfully with one whitespace warning. git diff --check HEAD~3 HEAD returns 2 for the same new blank line at EOF. The coordinator retained the frozen artifacts.

driver_review: Reviewed validate.py and runtime.py. Runtime MAME/bsnes argument order and WRAM address conversion match tools/a16_fuzz.py; fixture object code is produced by supplied llc with LTO disabled. No independent runtime execution was performed by this reviewer.
